title: Warm-up: FizzBuzz
prompt: Read an integer n from input. For each number from 1 to n print "Fizz" if it is divisible by 3, "Buzz" if divisible by 5, "FizzBuzz" if divisible by both, and the number otherwise.

title: Word frequency
prompt: Read one line of text. Print each distinct word (lower-cased, punctuation stripped) with its count, most frequent first; break ties alphabetically.
sample_input: The cat and the hat. And the bat!

title: Free practice
prompt: Write any Python program you like.
